## HEADER

-   **Description**: This script is used to compare the datafiles produced for the ERAP 3.0 update to those used in the 2.0 update. The code in this script assumes you have run through the 001_generate_full_index.qmd and those dfs are already loaded into the environment.
-   **Original Author**: Brendan Chen
-   **Date of Creation**: 10/05/2025

```{r dependencies}
## libraries
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(tidycensus)
library(tigris)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(skimr)
library(urbnthemes)
options(scipen = 999999)
options(tigris_use_cache = F)

```

```{r load in 2.0 data}

data_catalog_index_old <- read_csv(here("data", "comparison-data", "data_catalog_index_nonspatial.csv")) %>% 
  select(-num_eli_renters)

data_catalog_2021_acs <- read_csv(here("data", "comparison-data", "data_catalog_index_2.0_2025.csv")) %>% 
  rename(hh_chars_subindex_value = hh_chars_value,
         median_monthly_housing_cost = median_monthly_housing_coust)

data_catalog_2023_acs <- read_csv(here("data", "comparison-data", "data_catalog_index_2025.csv")) %>% 
  rename(hh_chars_subindex_value = hh_chars_value,
         median_monthly_housing_cost = median_monthly_housing_coust)



```

```{r}

# --- Step 1: Merge by ID ---
acs_2021_merged <- merge(
  data_catalog_index_old,
  data_catalog_2021_acs,
  by = "geoid",
  suffixes = c("_old", "_new")
)

# --- Step 2: Compare each common variable and create flag columns ---
# Find the columns (excluding ID) that exist in both data frames
common_cols <- intersect(
  setdiff(names(data_catalog_index_old), "geoid"),
  setdiff(names(data_catalog_2021_acs), "geoid")
)

# Create flags only for columns present in BOTH data frames
for (col in common_cols) {
  old_col <- paste0(col, "_old")
  new_col <- paste0(col, "_new")
  flag_col <- paste0(col, "_flag")

  acs_2021_merged[[flag_col]] <- as.integer(
    acs_2021_merged[[old_col]] != acs_2021_merged[[new_col]]
  )
}

# --- Step 3: Optional summary of differences ---
flag_cols <- grep("_flag$", names(acs_2021_merged), value = TRUE)
acs_2021_merged$any_diff <- as.integer(rowSums(acs_2021_merged[flag_cols]) > 0)

```

```{r}

diff_summary <- acs_2021_merged %>%
  summarise(across(ends_with("flag"), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

score_diff <- acs_2021_merged %>%
  mutate(index_diff = index_value_new - index_value_old) %>% 
  select(geoid, state_name_old, county_name_old, index_value_old, index_value_new, index_diff) %>% 
  filter(index_diff > 0) %>% 
  count(index_diff)
  


# Identify columns ending in "old" and "new"
old_cols <- acs_2021_merged %>% select(ends_with("old")) %>% names()
new_cols <- acs_2021_merged %>% select(ends_with("new")) %>% names()

# Strip suffixes to get base variable names
base_names_old <- str_remove(old_cols, "_old$")
base_names_new <- str_remove(new_cols, "_new$")

# Find common base names
common_vars <- intersect(base_names_old, base_names_new)

# Calculate missingness for old and new columns
missing_old <- acs_2021_merged %>% 
  summarise(across(all_of(paste0(common_vars, "_old")), ~mean(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_rate") %>% 
  mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_old$"), type = "old")

missing_new <- acs_2021_merged %>% 
  summarise(across(all_of(paste0(common_vars, "_new")), ~mean(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_rate") %>% 
  mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_new$"), type = "new")

# Combine for comparison
missing_comparison <- bind_rows(missing_old, missing_new) %>%
  select(variable, type, missing_rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = missing_rate)

# View result
print(missing_comparison)


```


```{r}
# Assuming df1 and df2 are your two dataframes

# 1. Compare missingness
missing_old <- data_catalog_index_old %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~mean(is.na(.)))) %>% pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_rate_old")
missing_new <- data_catalog_2023_acs %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~mean(is.na(.)))) %>% pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_rate_new")

missing_comparison_year <- full_join(missing_old, missing_new, by = "variable")

# 2. Compare distributions for numeric variables
numeric_vars <- data_catalog_index_old %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()

# Plot histograms side-by-side
plot_list <- map(numeric_vars, function(var) {
  combined <- bind_rows(
    data_catalog_index_old %>% select(all_of(var)) %>% mutate(source = "data_catalog_index_old"),
    data_catalog_2023_acs %>% select(all_of(var)) %>% mutate(source = "data_catalog_2023_acs")
  )
  
  ggplot(combined, aes_string(x = var, fill = "source")) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 30) +
    labs(title = paste("Distribution of", var), x = var, y = "Count")
})



# export results
write_csv(score_diff, "2021_acs_score_differences.csv")

write_csv(missing_comparison, "2021_acs_missing_comparison.csv")

write_csv(missing_comparison_year, "new_old_missing_comparison.csv")


pdf("plots_output.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # Set PDF output file and dimensions

for (plot in plot_list) {
  print(plot)  # Print each plot to the PDF
}

dev.off() 



```
